social_circle.name: Evan Bost

demographics.education: High school diploma with some community college coursework

background.how_they_met: Evan is Laura's younger brother; they grew up together in the same household in Modesto and later Atwater.
background.why_close: They are close in a teasing, practical sibling way. Laura helps him understand bills and forms, while he helps the family with physical tasks.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts casually several times a week, often with jokes, short questions, memes, and unfinished plans. He uses more slang than Laura and is quicker to react emotionally or politically.

shared_activities: family errands and occasional paperwork help
recent_text_topics: Evan asking Laura to explain a bill or online form before he ignores the deadline.
Running jokes about Laura making spreadsheets for everything and Evan under-planning everything.
Family dinner logistics, including whether their parents need help with appointments, furniture, or paperwork.
Occasional political texts where Evan uses activist language and Laura tries to keep the conversation concrete.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Laura has a younger brother, Evan, age 22, and that they are close in a teasing way: he thinks she over-plans and she thinks he under-plans. Q06 says they text a few times a week, usually jokes or him asking her to explain a bill or form. Q35 says her brother helps their parents with physical tasks.

social_circle.name: Denise Bost

demographics.occupation: produce quality control worker and seasonal administrative support
demographics.education: High school diploma plus some community college office and bookkeeping classes

background.how_they_met: Denise is Laura's mother and raised her in a working-class Central Valley agricultural family.
background.why_close: Denise is Laura's main family emotional check-in person. They share habits of organization, practical care, and concern for family stability, though Denise's worrying can sometimes amplify Laura's anxiety.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in full sentences with check-ins, reminders, and practical questions. She may send multiple messages in a row when worried and often mixes emotional support with logistics.

recent_text_topics: Scheduling or confirming Sunday dinner and asking what Laura wants to bring.
Questions about online health portals, appointment reminders, referrals, or insurance letters.
Checking whether Laura is eating, sleeping, and not staying too late at the lab.
Small family updates about Evan, relatives, gas prices, weather, and upcoming birthdays.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Laura's parents are very important, that her mother is the emotional check-in person, and that the family texts about practical things like weather, appointments, and help moving furniture. Q35 says Laura helps with online portals and reminders. Q40 says Laura often handles online forms while her mother keeps paper folders. Q101-Q104 describe her mother's education and produce quality-control or seasonal administrative work.

social_circle.name: Maya Alvarez

background.how_they_met: Laura and Maya likely met through Central Valley environmental, hiking, or science-adjacent circles; the interview explicitly identifies Maya as a close friend who works in environmental compliance.
background.why_close: Maya is calm, practical, well-read, and able to support Laura without making her feel judged. She connects with Laura through hiking, environmental issues, science, and grounded emotional support.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in clear, steady sentences. She asks useful questions, sends links or screenshots when relevant, and gives concise reassurance rather than dramatic emotional language.

shared_activities: discussing environmental justice and local politics
recent_text_topics: Laura's anxiety before work presentations and whether she should ask for a second set of eyes earlier.
The Raman data problem where Maya reminded Laura that data problems are not moral failures.
Planning a hike or coffee meet-up around heat, smoke, work schedules, and Laura's study nights.
Environmental justice, policing, air quality, and Central Valley climate issues.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 names Maya as one of Laura's closest friends, says Maya works in environmental compliance, and says they hike or get coffee about twice a month. Q07 also says Maya is usually Laura's first call when something goes wrong. Q44 says Laura texted Maya during a bad work week and Maya came over with takeout. Q30 says Maya challenges Laura because she is practical and well-read.

social_circle.name: Elise Navarro

demographics.occupation: gallery assistant and part-time art instructor

background.how_they_met: Laura and Elise likely met through local art, museum, or painting circles; the interview explicitly describes Elise as Laura's art friend.
background.why_close: They share a quiet creative rhythm, a love of museums, and low-pressure time together. Elise gives Laura a friendship space centered on art rather than work performance.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts warmly and visually, often sending photos of paintings, museum events, color palettes, and short encouraging notes. Uses occasional emoji but not constant slang.

shared_activities: painting together at Elise's kitchen table
private support texts during stressful periods
recent_text_topics: Planning a Fresno Art Museum or Studio Art Gallery visit that fits Laura's budget.
Sharing photos of watercolor progress, trail pictures, or color ideas.
Checking in when Laura has been stressed but does not want to post publicly.
Discussing representation in art spaces and local gallery events.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 names Elise as one of Laura's closest friends and says she is Laura's art friend. It says they go to the Fresno Art Museum or Studio Art Gallery and sometimes paint together at Elise's kitchen table. Q49 says Laura sometimes messages Elise privately for emotional support. Q30 says Elise is more focused on representation in art spaces.

social_circle.name: Michael Bost

demographics.occupation: agricultural equipment maintenance and field logistics worker
demographics.education: High school diploma with equipment and safety training through work

background.how_they_met: Michael is Laura's father and raised her in a Central Valley family connected to orchards, field work, irrigation, and harvest schedules.
background.why_close: He is quieter than Laura's mother but shows care through practical help, especially car or apartment issues. Laura's interest in systems and practical science was partly shaped by him explaining agricultural conditions and equipment.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts briefly and practically, often about logistics, weather, car issues, or whether Laura got home safely. He is not effusive, but he responds quickly when something needs fixing.

recent_text_topics: Checking on Laura's car maintenance after a recent repair and insurance expense.
Weather, heat, irrigation, and whether summer air-conditioning or gas costs are getting bad.
Confirming family dinner times or asking if Laura can help with an online form.
Short check-ins after Laura drives home late or visits family.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Laura's father is quieter but shows up if there is a car issue or something with the apartment, and that the family texts about practical matters. Q01 says her dad did equipment and field work around orchards and packing operations and once explained dry soil and irrigation to her. Q100 and Q106-Q107 describe his high school education, equipment maintenance, field support, logistics, irrigation support, and agricultural work.
